skills.description: Convert AutoCAD DWG files directly to Google Earth KML in one step — no manual CAD work. The pipeline is DWG →(accoreconsole.exe)→ DXF →(ezdxf + pyproj)→ KML →(optional)→ Google Earth. Auto-detects the coordinate system (WGS84 lon/lat vs UTM meters), reprojects UTM to WGS84, smooths curves (handles LWPOLYLINE bulge / ARC / SPLINE), colors by layer ACI, highlights boundary/red-line layers in thick red, and fills closed polylines on configured layers (e.g. 0-j1-1 → yellow 50%). Use when the user sends a CAD (.dwg) file and wants a KML/Google Earth view, or says "把这个CAD转成KML", "转KML导入Google Earth", "DWG to KML", "把总平面图放到地球上". This skill supersedes the inline DXF→KML guidance previously in dwg-to-dxf.
